channel.title: Dalen Michaels
channel.description: Dalen Michaels is a surf creator, founder of Out The Back, and cast member of Destination X season 2 (NBC / Peacock). Brand partnerships, mentorship, and speaking out of Boca Raton, Florida.

item.title: how i got cast on destination x
item.description: a surf guy from boca on a network reality show. how the casting happened, what the show is, and what a blacked-out bus across europe teaches you.

item.title: the relatable video you don't realize is an ad
item.description: how i get 2 million views on a sponsored tiktok shot in my bathroom, and why most brand content dies on arrival.

item.title: what it's like to surf a hurricane
item.description: matthew, dorian, isaias, milton. why florida surfers wait for storms, what it actually feels like, and why i still tell you not to do it.
